description: THREAT-EV-CHASE. Round 1 Custodes mirror, P1 Movement, both seats HUMAN. P2's Allarus Custodians is staged inside P1's deployment. A melee unit only abandons its objective to attack when the trade pays (our charge next turn vs the Allarus's charge on us first): Custodian Guard (+~1.4 VP) still attack it, but Blade Champions and Prosecutors (wiped first, barely scratch it back) decline and keep their objective moves. The plan notes show the trade value.
